method.period: One numeric D anchor is one period; preserve original period number and source-row ID.
method.merged_cells: Resolve only within actual merges. Distinct numbered D anchors sharing one E merge remain distinct periods.
method.unnumbered_content: Keep separate source content anchors, including D merge children; never invent period counts.
method.electives: Cumulative practice game. Default prior-week core details, including source-extracted HKI. Same-week earlier content requires teacher confirmation.
method.review: On tap, On thi, Tong on and Luyen de are review, not formal assessment or new topic coverage.
method.source_dates: Date-styled XML numbers retained with style_id; no 2026-2027 calendar dates inferred.

ambiguities.action: Use each grade sheet week, never calendar dates or a common exam week. Calendar says weeks31/37; G11/G12 examinations are weeks29/35.

Subject says elective but D:E are blank. Preserve as sections without numbered periods, not extra games.
